status: DECLARED before the governing leave-one-month-out run (tools/run_pop_signals.py --declaration configs/pop_signals_v3.json); the eight-seed scratch reads that motivated the candidates are disclosed below (scratch harness, same months and seeds, a slightly different no-NM definition); three scratch combinations were still running at declaration time and are not read
purpose: Two further label-free changes to the v9 LIRF population classifier, on top of configs/pop_signals_v1.json's previous-arrival identity (v42's candidate). (1) Operator descriptors of the row's flight prefix in the row's calendar month, from every LIRF movement of the file: the prefix's arrival fill share (in-block = scheduled arrival within the fill tolerance) smoothed towards the month's arrival fill share, its arrival count, and over the prefix's departures the share without an NM record, the share without an airport aircraft type and the departure count. They describe what kind of operator the row belongs to (an airline whose other movements are NM-filed and typed, or an operator whose movements are mostly unfiled), which the flight-prefix categorical cannot do for rare or unseen prefixes. (2) Stake weighting of the classifier fit: each fitting row weighs |schedule interval - the normal component's band value|, clipped to [600, 20000] s and scaled to mean 1, so the fit spends its capacity where the fill/normal decision moves the squared error, which is what the mixture is scored on.

control.description: v9's seventeen classifier features, the same protocol and seed bag, unweighted (identical to the v1 and v2 controls)

pa_stake.description: v1's pa features, the classifier fitted with the stake weights

pa_op.description: pa + op_arr_fill_m + op_arr_n_m (the prefix's smoothed arrival fill share and log1p arrival count in the row's month), unweighted

pa_opall.description: pa + the two arrival descriptors + prefix_nonm_m, prefix_notype_m, prefix_n_m (the prefix's departures in the month: no-NM share, no-type share, log1p count), unweighted

feature_definitions.prefix: the first three characters of FLIGHT_mvt ('?' when missing), for departures and arrivals alike (src/prc2026_final/pop_signals._prefix)
feature_definitions.op_arr_fill_m: (fills among the prefix's LIRF arrivals in the row's calendar month + 5 x the month's LIRF arrival fill share) / (the prefix's arrivals in the month + 5); a fill = |in-block - scheduled arrival| <= the mixture's fill tolerance (120 s); a prefix with no arrivals in the month gets the month's share (src/prc2026_final/pop_signals.operator_descriptors)
feature_definitions.op_arr_n_m: log1p(the prefix's LIRF arrivals in the month); 0 when none
feature_definitions.prefix_nonm_m: share of the prefix's LIRF departures in the month (every departure of the file, not only the population) whose ADEP_flt is missing (no NM flight record)
feature_definitions.prefix_notype_m: share of the prefix's LIRF departures in the month whose AIRCRAFT_TYPE_mvt is missing
feature_definitions.prefix_n_m: log1p(the prefix's LIRF departures in the month)
feature_definitions.availability: every input is a supplied movement column of the same file; in a leave-one-month-out fold the held-out month's own movements give its descriptors, as the ranking file's movements do for January and July 2026; no departure label or departure block time is read
feature_definitions.stake_weight: for each fitting row |schedule_interval_s - band_values(normal component fitted on the same fitting rows)| clipped to [floor_s, cap_s], divided by the mean over the fitting rows; passed as LightGBM row weights to every inner date-grouped fold (fit and early-stopping metric) and to the final booster (src/prc2026_final/pop_signals.stake_weights, fit_bag); the normal component itself is unchanged (band medians)

scope: population rows with a schedule interval at or below the mixture threshold (43,200 s), as configs/pop_signals_v1.json
protocol: as configs/pop_signals_v1.json: leave-one-month-out over the twelve 2025 months, classifier and normal component fitted on the other eleven months, mixture on the held-out rows, squared error against the held-out label

rule.selection: unchanged from configs/pop_signals_v1.json: among candidates at least 3% below the control's twelve-month in-scope SSE, better in at least 8 of 12 months, with the paired-month bootstrap 95% interval below zero, the lowest SSE; otherwise nothing
rule.note: the report also states each candidate's January and July readings and a ranking-composition read (below) for the user's decision; they are informational, not selection criteria

ranking_composition_read.definition: the January and July 2025 per-row in-scope SSE of the control and the candidate, each scaled to the ranking's in-scope population counts (104 January 2026 rows, 268 July 2026 rows), summed; informational

export: v43 = uploaded v40 + 0.75 x (mixture_selected - mixture_v9_shipped) on the in-scope ranking population rows, floored at -12 s, every other row byte-identical to v40 (tools/export_pop_signals.py --declaration configs/pop_signals_v3.json --version 43); a v43 REPLACES v42's population delta (v42 = the pa candidate, built at the user's word, not uploaded) rather than stacking on it; the selected candidate's bag is fitted on all twelve 2025 months with the declared seeds and, for a stake-weighted candidate, the stake weights of those rows
